definitions.explanation: The break from school or work during summer.

examples.english: We're going to the beach with the family during summer vacation.

notes:
{夏休|なつやす}み is the summer vacation period. In Japan, school summer break typically runs from late July to late August (about 40 days).

SEASONAL VACATIONS:
- ⟦{春休|はるやす}み→春休み：19115_haruyasumi⟧: spring break (late March–early April)
- {夏休|なつやす}み: summer vacation (late July–late August)
- ⟦{冬休|ふゆやす}み→冬休み：19114_fuyuyasumi⟧: winter break (late December–early January)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夏休|なつやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧: summer homework
- {夏休|なつやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由研究|じゆうけんきゅう}→自由研究：28022_jiyuukenkyuu⟧: independent study project (a school tradition)
- {夏休|なつやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: summer vacation begins

CULTURE:
{夏休|なつやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧ is a hallmark of Japanese school life. Students often rush to finish it in the last days of vacation — a relatable cultural topic.
